next.reason: 1985: USE procedures run 'after completion of the standard input-output exception routine upon the unsuccessful execution of an input-output operation unless an AT END phrase takes precedence', for file-name-1, OUTPUT and EXTEND, excluding files named by file-name-1 in another USE. 2023: §2023:14.9.49.4 GR6 the same timing, 'unless an AT END or INVALID KEY phrase takes precedence', with the same file-name-1, OUTPUT and EXTEND cases and exclusion; §2023:14.9.49.4 GR5 'a USE statement specifying file-name-1 takes precedence over any USE statements specifying an INPUT, OUTPUT, I-O, or EXTEND phrase'; §2023:14.9.49.4 GR3 a) 'All format 1 USE statements in which file-name-1 is specified are examined' first; §2023:9.1.14 'control is transferred according to the rules of any applicable exception processing statements'. The exception-checking PERFORM preamble cannot apply to a 1985 program; INVALID KEY does not reach report files. Same effect.
